scientific.integrity: The claim is derived directly from the published full-disorder Riccati map, the exact disk-automorphism defect identity, Jensen's circle integral, and a bounded martingale strong law. A standalone standard-library replay checks all finite algebraic identities and representative finite-horizon behavior. The direct source and the closest general random-Mobius literature were compared at the statement level.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is for the full-disorder normalized Riccati map with interior initial data and does not establish a corresponding rate for partial disorder. An equivalent result may exist under general SU(1,1) or random-Mobius terminology not recovered by the searches.

title: Exact radial burn-in exponent for the full-disorder quantum-walk Riccati circle
